name: DadsBot
summary: A warm biographer-style interview app for capturing long-form oral histories with recording, transcription, memory primers, and session summaries.
story: DadsBot is the family-recording project: one-button capture, automatic speech-to-text, assistant follow-ups, and a memory layer so the next conversation knows what came before.

name: OpenSore
summary: AI-assisted workplace evidence investigation for lawyers, HR, boards, and compliance teams.
story: OpenSore turns scattered emails, chats, documents, calendars, notes, and exports into source-backed timelines, contradiction checks, and structured investigation work product.

name: OpenSnoRE
summary: A browser app, PWA, and Mac-app experiment with fake snores for boring moments and guided exercises for quieter nights.
story: OpenSnoRE started as a ridiculous snore button and grew into a playful sleep-audio lab: procedural snores, boring-situation theater, share loops, and a real stop-snoring side quest.

name: iMessage Cleanup
summary: Interactive exporter and iCloud storage cleaner: exports per-person archives (database, transcript, media) and frees space by removing local attachment copies.
story: Old conversations are decisions, context, favors, family and receipts. Export the people who matter into durable per-person archives, then reclaim the gigabytes Messages hoards. For the nightly all-conversations archive, pair it with iMessage Sync.

launcher.short: Export per-person archives & free iCloud space
launcher.long: Interactive exporter and iCloud storage cleaner: exports per-person archives (database, transcript, media) and frees space by removing local attachment copies.

name: repo2audiobook
summary: Converts a GitHub repository into a narrated audiobook/podcast using OpenAI TTS, with modes like investor diligence, technical deep-dive, and beginner. Run setup once to install dependencies, then run repo2audiobook.py with a repo URL.
